title: Bookishness
summary: BOOK'ISHNESS, noun Addictedness to books; fondness for study. BOOK'-KEEPER, noun [book and keep.] One who keeps accounts, or the accounts of another; the officer who has the charge of keeping the book

inlines.v: BOOK'ISHNESS, noun Addictedness to books; fondness for study. BOOK'-KEEPER, noun [book and keep.] One who keeps accounts, or the accounts of another; the officer who has the charge of keeping the books and accounts in a public office.
